verdict.rationale: Oneleet publishes a documented public API: a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with 157 paths, plus a 25-path Auditor API. Both have Scalar-rendered interactive references linked from the docs and authenticate with scoped service keys meant for agents and scripts. Routes are URI-versioned under /api/v1/ with deprecation guidance in the spec, and the probe 404s on docs.oneleet.com do not contradict this because the spec is served from api.oneleet.com. Missing for 10: a published versioning/deprecation policy or changelog with a stated notice window, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API calls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
